chapter: Buddy Petit and Sam Morgan years
title: Leaving Buddy Petit to join Sam Morgan
summary: Sam Morgan asks for Williams for road trips because Petit's regular drummer could not travel, and Williams stays with Sam from 1921 on.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: He had me playing with Sam.

And Sam was going on the road every weekend, see, going to Biloxi, Paris Christiane, Bay St. Louis. Well, Manny Gabriel couldn't get off, you see, to go on the road with Sam and play. He was a slate or carpet or something. We was playing at the economy hall one night, and he'd come and ask Buddy to let me go make a trip with him, you see. Buddy didn't like the idea, you know. He figured Sam wanted to take me anyway, you see. I just said come back from California, you see. Mm-hmm. So he said, well, I don't like the idea, Sam. He said, well, you know, if Alfred want to go, he can go, but I know what you're trying to do. You're trying to steal my drummer. That's what you're trying to do. Well, as Manny Gabriel couldn't go on the road at any time, well, he kept me because I liked the road, you see. And Buddy didn't go no way. He just played around here, you know, see. So I made the first trip there and got acquainted over the lake, and everybody liked it. Told me, told Sam he had a better drummer than why they tried to keep me, you know. So I just stayed on with Sam. See, that was from 1921. And I stayed with Sam from 21 to 25. From 1925 until the band broke up, you know, I'd say.

So you were with Buddy a real short length of time. Short length of time, yeah. I wouldn't say it was about too long. Oh, what about Armstrong? You said you played with him at Lollars? Yeah. And you played a lot of little parties with him?
